capabilities: Render brew code blocks as recipe cards with specs, ratio, steps and target
Report recipe problems with line numbers and fixes under the card
Color the recipe syntax and underline problems while editing
Suggest brewers, actions, grind sizes, units and qualifiers while typing
Customize card theme, accent, size and units, or via CSS variables
extras: Not yet in the community catalog, so it must be installed manually from a release; the format is documented on a separate page and a playground is linked.
problem: Obsidian shows code blocks as plain text, so structured coffee recipes are hard to read and easy to get wrong without validation.
summary: Renders coffee recipes written in a Brewlang code block as styled recipe cards, with line-level problems reported for the recipe.
